title: Group action
summary: A group action describes how reversible transformations move objects while respecting composition.

content.plain: A group action describes how reversible transformations move objects while respecting composition.
content.exact: A left action of G on X is a map G×X→X with e·x=x and (gh)·x=g·(h·x).
content.example: Rotations act on points of the plane.
content.caveat: The same group can act on the same set in inequivalent ways.
